messages:
emily: T-minus 30 to the change window. Quick checklist before we start: pins, schema, and any exemptions? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Planned deploy: 2026-04-05T00:00Z -> release/2026-04-05. Canary plan: 4% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Smoke hooks: auth, embeddings, cost-sampler. Rollback tool available. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-04-05

tom: Ack. I verified the stable pin to api:v3.5.1 and pushed config locks. Command used: `infractl pin set api v3.5.1`

rachel: Heads up: no DB migrations during freeze. Ops asked for freeze from T-20 to T+80. Please avoid global flags.

ops-oncall: Oncall here. Rollback thresholds in runbook: error_rate > 1% for 4m OR p95 > 550ms for 3m OR NPS-critical errors. I have `deploy-bot rollback --to previous --reason "auto-threshold"` ready.

chris: Canary small smoke started. Initial metrics: p50 +9ms, p95 280ms, error_rate 0.2%. Looks clean.

emily: Posting release-notes snippet to #release-notes: "v3.5.1: stability fixes for reranker, embedding throughput improvements, safe rollback pins."

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 20% -> running cost and latency hooks. Canary dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/canary-2026-04-05

tom: Observability check: alert platform connected, tracing tags present, sampling at 10%. Also validated fallback model variant: model:v3.5.1-quant available for auto-fallback.

chris: At 60% ramp we saw two short-lived 502s on a single region node, retried and recovered. error_rate peaked at 0.9% for 90s. Not meeting rollback.

ops-oncall: Noted. If the same node repeats errors we'll cordon it and roll back that instance. Manual rollback command ready.

rachel: Reminder to SREs: freeze means no ad-hoc infra changes. If you need an exemption, DM me with justification.

emily: Proceed to final ramp. I'll extend the freeze to T+100 for handback buffer as requested by ops.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% -> finalizing. Summary link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-04-05/summary

chris: Post-deploy smoke: all green, traces look normal, cost sampler within expected band.

tom: Created a short post-deploy note in the runbook about the transient 502s and the cordon action we used for the node.

ops-oncall: Handback scheduled at T+100 to SRE onshift. Runbook snapshot and latency baseline uploaded. If anyone needs an emergency unpin before handback completes, tag me.

emily: Great job team. Closing thread in 10m if no incidents. If anyone needs to reopen, start a new thread with the incident tag. :rocket:
